g.title: TOP → A.D1, A.LB382, A.PARAM, A.S3, A.UBshat, A.UNIQ (uses)

TOP — s(11) = s-hat, equality only for Trump mod G (S1) [open — own work done; waiting on dependencies] The composed theorem. Open until every 'open' descendant below closes. [own_tier lean-proved: the composition is already a Lean theorem from the axioms]

A.D1 — Attainment: s(11) is a minimum (D1) [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A68): Lean theorem attained_thm (axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound only). No Hausdorff limits: compactness of the coordinate feasible region (33 coords + side in [0,11]; containment = the set_subset_container_iff inequalities, non-overlap closed because interior(PSq.set) = the OPEN u/v box, mem_interior_iff_uv) + continuity of the side projection; explicit 11-in-a-row packing for nonemptiness; parametrize (A64) maps set-level packings in. TopLevel roster 13 -> 12 named axioms.

A.PARAM — Every packing is represented in (cx,cy,t), t in [0,1] [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A64): prose + Lean theorem (axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound only). The square's own 90-degree symmetry (sqSet_rot) brings the edge vector into the closed first quadrant; the half-angle substitution t = e2/(1+e1) is exact algebra - no transcendental functions. Also provides the u/v membership and w-containment characterisations + w quasiconcavity that the measure bridge consumes.

A.LB382 — Theorem 1: s(11) >= 3.82 [lean-proved] Two independent exact verifiers (verify_measure.py; Lean checkMeasureI via native_decide) AND, since A64, the END-TO-END Lean theorem s_eleven_ge_382 (Measure382.lean): native_decide evaluation + the formalised bridge A.F2; axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound + the native_decide axiom. 'Lean proves s(11) >= 3.82', not just 'Lean checks the checker'.

A.S3 — s-hat is THE octic root (isolation certificate) [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A63). The octic has exactly 2 real roots; the one in [3.877083, 3.877084] is the second; all Taylor coefficients at the left endpoint above degree 0 are positive, so the Lean uniqueness proof is calculus-free. 5 corruption gates fail as required.

Proved corner by corner; Trump TL satisfies RES(1) (canary: critical, TL 2-crowd locked, not excluded). Composition: k0_00 = SEL-Psi + NOCRIT-SEL + [not RES(4)] + K0-FREE; DF-K0/H1 not consumed; Lean obligations N1-N5. T3 [M]: 520/520 directed exits freed by the non-deepest intruder; 508/520 translation-retreatable; BLIND hunt 0/167.

K0.RES4 — not-RES(4): no K0-BLOCKED Psi-minimal minimiser is a frame (>= 3-square wall-to-wall columns in both axes through 8 intruders + 3 free) [open] A90-G1, the exact k0 residue after NOCRIT-SEL. Evidence: 0 K0-BLOCKED FJ points in 167 certified + 520 directed seeds; lowest K0-BLOCKED packing found 3.985 (s-hat + 0.108); RES fails at 2 of the 4 stuck endpoints (a genuine extra hypothesis). Routes: (a) Lemma PLATEAU (K0.PLATEAU) refutes the archetype family; (b) the frame CENSUS is DEAD (A91: L1 = 5.7e28 orbits exact, realisable ~1e38, 28 orders above the tree; combinatorics constrain nothing, geometry kills 99.7% at 4 ms; mismatch law, 4th face); (c) fallback = the A85 tree (K0.TREE) with the anchoring rows as per-node prunes (design pending, A91). || A91 close-out: the residue is WALL-ANCHORED frames (Trump archetype included), which no combinatorial or box-level linear row excludes — they die only by geometry, i.e. the A85 tree; not-RES(4) stays a SelForm (C) leaf of the tree (A90 6(i)); frame census DEAD (1.3e32 CPU-h, 28 orders). Design (frame_census.md 9): anchoring rows as (C-sel) per-node tests in the tree (roles from reach boxes, retreat types from argmin-side rows, anchoring existence as a graph search over touch-capable boxes); sound, expected silent at the frontier (existential-filter law); pricing = a 1-desktop-hour chore on A85's stored gate samples + 12 LP nodes, named, not run. || A92 (PI target, 2026-09-03): prove K0-BLOCKED => side >= s-hat directly, split (S) substantive crowding (second intruder depth >= delta at every corner; empirical frontier suggests boundary > 4) + (N) nicked corners by selection / pin slack / JAM-0; universal form is no easier than the theorem (k1 packings can be nicked into K0-BLOCKED: s0115 at 3.985 with 1e-8 nicks). || SUPERSEDED (A92): the residue is now stated as RES-N (K0.RESN) after the crowd-certificate chain + Lemma SLIDE; RES(4) kept as an audit record. || A92 (2026-09-03, docs/proofs/k0_blocked_side.md): the residue re-split by DEPTH instead of by frames. (S) substantive (every corner's 2nd intruder depth >= delta) is a WEIGHTED root measure certificate (Lemma CW: mu >= 1 everywhere, mu >= 1+e on the crowd family F_c(a_w), total < 11+8e; verified by TWO runs of the frozen verify_case.py on one measure) - the brief's '8-core K-leaf' does not exist (the depth-delta pose set has EMPTY core for delta < 0.134). Theorem CEIL [T]: max(mu_A, mu_B) >= 1/(cos a + sin a) >= 1/sqrt2 for any two disjoint unit squares in a quadrant => per-corner min(d1,d2) <= 1 - 1/sqrt2 = 0.2929 (equality: the diagonal 45-deg pair); pair charge <= 1 so area alone (4 < E(s-hat) = 4.0318) never closes (S). (N) nicked: Lemma SLIDE [T, forall-packings, modulo K0-O1]: slide the shallow intruders' retreat clusters along the diagonal, grow the container, teleport => a K0-BLOCKED packing at side m < s-hat has d2(c) >= s-hat - m at EVERY corner. Composition (Theorem N): a crowd certificate C(delta, m_lo) (pad 0.4403 (s0 - m_lo) < delta) + SLIDE + K0-FREE kill every side in [m_lo, s-hat - delta]; a chain of certificates converges geometrically (ratio 0.4403) and gives s(11) >= s-hat - delta_inf, delta_inf = where the LP stops passing. EXACT RESIDUE RES-N(delta_inf): K0-BLOCKED packings at side m in (s-hat - delta_inf, s-hat) with some corner's 2nd intruder at depth in [s-hat - m, delta_inf) (+ nicked non-images at s-hat for uniqueness). [M] CERTIFIED at delta = 0.3, e = 1: certs/runA_S_d0.3_e1_v2.json + runB_S_d0.3_e1_v2.json (frozen verify_case.py depth 56, 0 holes, re-verified by the lead) => Theorem S(0.3) on the window [3.82, s0), boundary s0 = 3.877084; delta = 0.2 OPEN (its 900-s tau 18.10 < 19 was a non-converged lower bound, 18.42 after 2926 s more; certificate fails on geometry, 65/65 holes inside the crowd family), delta <= 0.1 dead at the LP level (at 0.05 tau = 11(1+e) exactly). Residue of the whole k0_00 problem below s-hat: RES-N(delta_inf) with delta_inf = 0.3 certified - K0-BLOCKED packings at side m in (s-hat - delta_inf, s-hat) with a corner whose 2nd intruder has depth in [s-hat - m, delta_inf).

K0.PLATEAU — Lemma PLATEAU / W-GEN: mutual (I)-anchorings (A90 [S] -> A91 W-GEN [T]); NOT load-bearing [proved-prose] CORRECTION (A91 close-out, 2026-09-03): the "archetype is 100% (I)-anchored" measurement was a minimal-chain artefact; recomputed with A90's full cluster every archetype cluster is WALL-anchored, so PLATEAU is not what the archetype needs. Residual gap A91-G1 (termination of the slide iteration for tilted-D rate ties, codim >= 1) is NOT load-bearing: even closed, wall-anchored frames remain and die only by geometry. Kept as an audit record.

K0.TFU — TF-U + LOCK / MENU / JAM-0 (A89): selected-minimiser tilt structure [proved-prose] A89 [T]: at the Phi-minimal sigma-minimiser every non-flush-locked square has tilt exactly 0 (TF-U); LOCK (Gordan), MENU (a wall blocker is locked only by far-side contacts), JAM-0 (axis-aligned offset blocker pins its partner). GAP A89-G1: the loaded tilt floor theta_0 > 0 is NOT provable locally (near-flush jam is loaded-consistent); empirical floor 23.9 deg. Measured: near-flush zone is NOT where the tree cost is; self-jammed pairs 1.9%, jammed reach 2.386 ~ max.

Depth pair prune (t2b): no realisable pair has both intruders at depth >= 0.5.

g.title: K0.TREE — A85 zone tree over k0_00 (fallback): 3,200-7,000 CPU-h [open] A85 pilot: object built (8 exact D4 images), sigma-equivariant reach cover, BL pair census 33,656 L2 pairs, alive gate 0.82 attemptable / 82% of 4-corner combos contradictory exactly; 12 LP rows: 6 PASS 5 FAIL 1 refused (~1,350-1,700 s per budget-10 node, 8-130 s at 3-4 corners deep). Every count-based alternative priced and dead: A88 contact structures (1e36 decorated / 1e11 graphs, 0.78 s each, loses on the count; graph-fixed Krawczyk closes 0/20), A91 frames (28 orders). Prunes available: K0.ID (4-shallow, depth pair prune), TF-U leaves, anchoring rows (A91 design). Compute-scale decision with the PI. || A91: k0_00 route = this tree, with not-RES(4) as a (C-sel) leaf and anchoring rows as optional per-node prunes; price unchanged. || A92: demoted to the fallback for the residue SHELL RES-N only (width delta_inf), not the whole class. || A99 (2026-09-04/05, notes/report99.md): the three PI reductions MEASURED on A85's own k0_00 nodes; net effect is a PRICE INCREASE, not the ~10x asked for. [M] R1 DEAD: 0 of 12 FAILed A85 certificates close by re-verification alone (frozen verify_case at depth 56 -> 64 -> 88, no new LP); hole counts do not fall, they rise (b595 10->11->17, b178 42->45->47, p210_001 8->11->19). Structural reason, established not assumed: verify_param starves the s-axis on a wide window so A96's resolve96 sub-window trick is real there, but verify_case's --depth budget is UNIFORM over the root split, so "witness box closes with k more bisections" IS "the global run at depth 56+k passes" and there is no resolution artefact to harvest. A85's k0_00 FAILs are LP ROW-GENERATION failures (admissible placements of exact mass < 1), not verifier-depth artefacts -- same conclusion A89-O3 reached for the 3-shallow root. Consequence: f2 ~ 0.85 has NO measured support; A85's own depth-2 rate is 1/3 first pass, 2/3 with eps_geo repairs (n = 3). Also found: A85's certs/k0_00/s1cor_near_b178_epsgeo0.002.json on disk has exact total 10.050003 >= budget 10 (rc = 2, proves nothing) -- a later certify round overwrote the certificate its .report.json describes. [M/T] R2 (Lemma ID exempt boxes at the root) is a COST MULTIPLIER of exactly x15: D4 quotients each shallow/deep branch only by the pattern's STABILISER, 1728/|stab| = 216*|orbit|, so the level-1 cell count over orbit reps is 216*16 = 3456, i.e. 3240 = 15 x 216 after deleting the 4-shallow class A89 killed at the root; and the ALL-DEEP branch keeps its 216 cells with NO exempt box at all, so R2 can never price the frontier below A85's figure. LP screen (20 stratified level-1 cells, plain vs 3-shallow at delta = 0.3 window-valid a_win = 0.6896936, 136 NoFams/corner, 300 s each, 52 launches): median tau drop 1.0567, eta <= -1.0 on 19/20 vs 6/20 plain -- BUT minmass halves (0.5093 -> 0.2396), i.e. the same A89-O3 delta-sweep signature: tau falls because the LP is LESS converged, not because the node is closer to dead. ZERO kills claimed; the arbiter leg did not run. [M] R3(c) is the ONE real reduction: A85's interior cell grid is already in A96's (P-aff) family (column step = (s0 - 2*c0)/16, c0 = 11/10, every edge e_q(s0) with 12q dyadic), so to_param96 emits with no new anchoring rule; certs/param/s1int_l2_l2_p210_001_epsgeo0.004.param.json PASSes the frozen 4-D verifier over the WHOLE window [3.82, s0] in 123.2 s, 0 witnesses, coverage 1.00000 -- a new window-valid kill of a node A85 killed only at s0. Window cost = +119 s on a 1 630-1 860 s node (+5-7 %) instead of x4 for a 4-side grid: a 3.8x cut on the window. Not uniform (the other emitted node, 53 atoms, timed out at 600 s, >= x77) and the four CORNER-CROWD nodes cannot be emitted at all (cores at 17/24, 91/72, 37/24, 41/72 are t-grid, not affine in s0) -- the corner side has no parametric route until an anchoring rule is proved; cover-invariance transport to the A38 cover is an OPEN obligation. R3(a) --jobs 4 vs 1 and R3(b) LP cold vs warm were queued and NEVER RAN (supervisor chain died) -- not measured. STACKED PROJECTION (results/projection99.json, A85 s.8.3 model with only f2 / branches / window replaced): f2 = 2/3, s0 only 8 903-20 636 CPU-h; window-valid with parametric re-emission and R2 off 9 341-21 661 CPU-h (130-301 desktop-days at 3 slots) -- 2.9-3.1x WORSE than the published 3 200-7 000, which was an f2 = 0.85 scenario R1 has now removed; with R2 branching 138 000-323 000. Chip A85 -> A99. || A113 (2026-09-06, geometry only): the k0 tree's cost is NOT concentrated near the k>=1 manifold -- only 1.4/4.6/17.6 percent of A99's 9,341-21,661 CPU-h lies within eta = 0.05/0.1/0.2 of a simple placement (eta = max(L-inf distance to the 36 corner-lattice cell centres, sqrt2 sin(tilt-gap/2))), and all five alive(LP) level-1 cells are FAR (eta 0.229-0.366), because the tree conditions on an INTERIOR square and every near-shat minimum has its interior squares tilted (Trump 40.2/49.8 deg, so the three Trump-image cells sit at eta 0.366 while the images themselves have 5 simple squares each). The POSITION term alone does guide: 0 of 26 processed cells with d_pos <= 0.05 was ever LP-killed vs 45 percent at d_pos >= 0.2 (Spearman -0.44, stable in every tilt bin), and the six most resistant cells (tau up to 10.500 > budget) are at d_pos <= 0.02; those 36 root cells carry 16.7 percent of the cost and no kill. LP wall is flat in eta, so cost is un-killability, not per-node price. The real signal is the DUAL SUPPORT: 3.40 simple placements per ALIVE support vs 0.81 per LP-killed one, the killed ones matching A107's S01 'room' shadow at s* = 4.000000 and the survivors partial skeletons of near-critical shadows (l1_100 an exact match to S38 @ 3.928915, s1int_l1_043 Jaccard 0.83 to S07 @ 3.885618) -- a re-branching rule, not a pre-branching one. Also: zero logic kills exist in this tree (nofams = [] in all 264 node jsons; Lemma ID needs a shallow corner). || A115 follow-up (2026-09-06, attempts/A115-k0-corner-rows/notes/t4_report.md): the CHEAP control beats the mechanism. A PLAIN 240 s warm re-solve of A99/A85's own open k0_00 node LPs -- no corner rows, no new mathematics, warm-started from each cell's stored atoms_all + rows_all -- followed by A99/A85's ordinary first-pass node certificate under the frozen verify_case.py, CERTIFIES 10 of the 55 open cells reached, including 7 of A99's plain level-1 cells, for 5.09 CPU-h: 303-702 CPU-h removed from A99's 9,341-21,661 CPU-h frontier (43.2-100.3 CPU-h per level-1 cell), a 59x-138x return, against the corner rows' net -13 CPU-h. l1_170 and l1_181 had NO prior verdict (A38 notrun); l1_005/049/093/126/137 upgrade an uncertified A38 LP-kill to a frozen-verifier certificate (l1_093 was previously a certification FAIL); all five converged with minmass 1.000 in 46-222 s. HARD NEGATIVE: four cells come back CONVERGED ALIVE with tau = budget exactly and minmass 1.000 (l1_071, l1_104, l1_159, s3_far_BL389484_TR018470) -- the case-LP has reached its optimum and it is not below budget, so no further LP time kills them; A113's 'un-killable at the measured LP state' list is upgraded from measured to converged. 36 cells remain kill-candidates whose first-pass certificate FAILs (row-generation-incomplete), 9 of the 64 open cells were not reached at the 5 CPU-h cap. || A115 follow-up 2 (2026-09-07, attempts/A115-k0-corner-rows/notes/t5_report.md): the plain warm re-solve pass continued to 15.36 CPU-h total and now certifies 17 DISTINCT level-1 cells of the k0_00 root split dead (16 newly), plus 6 level-2, 1 level-3 and 4 A85 nodes = 768-1,782 CPU-h off A99's 9,341-21,661 CPU-h frontier, a 48x-111x return, with NO new mathematics (A38/A85/A99's own case-LP warm-continued from their own atoms_all + rows_all, then their own node certificate under the frozen verify_case.py; A85's witness-feedback rounds convert 4 of the 36 first-pass cert-FAIL cells). A121's `i` table (incomplete supports) was the single best pointer: 14 of 14 of its cells certified, 7 of them level-1 A38 `undecided` cells that no A115 queue would have reached. HANDED TO A118: six level-1 cells (l1_071, l1_104, l1_148, l1_153, l1_158, l1_159) and the A85 node s3_far_BL389484_TR018470 are CONVERGED ALIVE (tau = budget exactly, minmass 1.000) - no further LP time kills them, they need the two-meeter cover; l1_159 is confirmed twice independently and l1_153 is a Trump-image cell, which must be alive. || A115 follow-up 3 (2026-09-07, attempts/A115-k0-corner-rows/notes/t6_report.md): the plain warm re-solve pass is COMPLETE over every open k0_00 cell A115 could reach. CUMULATIVE: 22 DISTINCT level-1 cells of the 216-cell root split certified dead (10.2 percent), plus 13 level-2, 2 level-3 and 10 A85/A99 nodes, for 29.83 CPU-h = 1,023-2,372 CPU-h off A99's 9,341-21,661 CPU-h frontier, a 34x-80x return, with NO new mathematics (each campaign's own case-LP warm-continued from its own atoms_all + rows_all, then its own node certificate under the frozen verify_case.py). Stage A (240 s plain) over the whole 142-cell never-run/open pool: 17 certified, 97 kill-candidate, 22 alive, 6 knife-edge. Stage B (900 s + A85 witness-feedback) on stage A's kill-candidates: 5 certified out of 26 reached, ALL FIVE level-1 (l1_149, l1_168, l1_169, l1_173, l1_174) -- cells whose plain certificate had FAILed -- so stage B is the highest-yield remaining move, with 71 of 97 candidates unreached. HAND-OFF (nothing run on them): TWELVE cells are CONVERGED ALIVE (tau = budget exactly, minmass 1.000) and need the two-meeter cover, not more LP: level-1 l1_071, l1_104, l1_124, l1_148, l1_153, l1_158, l1_159; level-2 l2_p114_001, l2_p65_101, l2_p65_111, l2_p74_001; and the A85 node s3_far_BL389484_TR018470. l1_153 is a Trump-image cell, which must be alive, and the LP agrees.

A.F2 — Measure bridge: checker PASS => mu(Q)>=1 for all Q => no packing [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A64): full checker soundness formalised (checkMeasureI_no_packing) - exact interval arithmetic, t-grid trigonometry (monotone rational cos/sin, no transcendentals), clip via w-quasiconcavity, sift/split/branch-and-bound induction, coverage, and the scaling/shrinking + counting argument (interior-disjoint packings handled via strict-interior pullback). The A28-estimated 3-5 day item. Axioms: propext/Choice/Quot.sound only (the bridge itself is native_decide-free).

V.MEAS — verify_measure.py soundness (+ Lean checkMeasureI evaluation) [lean-proved] LEAN-PROVED (A75): the Python DRIVER (Verifier.run/covered/root_boxes/main) is modelled as checkMeasurePy = checkMeasureI generalised by --tscale, the 4^k --split root grid (fuel = depth - 2k), the --strict-margin threshold (need >= wd), the no-drop known-inheritance of covered, an ARBITRARY shortlist oracle pick (the float prepass incl. its float-reject early return is one instance; pickAll = --no-float-prepass), and main's s<1 shortcut; checkMeasurePy_no_packing proves PASS => s(n) >= s for EVERY oracle/tscale/k/margin from the A64 primitives. Residual TCB = faithfulness of the model to the Python source (line-by-line table in attempts/A75-lean-wave5/notes/findings.md). Two implementations of the same integer decision core (Python A08; Lean checkMeasureI A06/A64) = the C3 second-implementation witness; both PASS the 3.80/3.82 certificates (box trees agree up to the root partition, README). Axioms: propext/Choice/Quot.sound only.

V.CASE — verify_case.py soundness (PASS => no packing satisfies the pin hypotheses) [lean-proved] LEAN-PROVED (A70): checkCaseI (Lean port of the decision core; core-Rat exempt tests over the A64 integer layer) + full soundness chain: sat_squares (SAT sufficiency for two squares - geometric Hahn-Banach + 4-cone support bound; the spec's one-parenthesis citation is now a machine-checked theorem), coreExempt_sound/nofamExempt_sound/exemptB_sound, goC_sound, checkCaseI_price = claim (P2) scaled by wd, priced_dichotomy_scaled, checkCaseI_no_family (B-NO) / checkCaseI_kill (the lemma_B hcert producer per PASS file - A68's named residue DISCHARGED). One certificate replayed end to end (k5_06.lo at s=191/50, native_decide; k5_06_lo_kill + k5_06_lo_kill_packing via lemma_B). Axioms: propext/Choice/Quot.sound (+ the per-theorem native_decide axiom on the replay only). RESIDUES: corpus-wide replay separately priced; B.2' owner-frame prose-only; single-side only (window = V.PARAM). FINDING: spec's 'a = 0 point core legal/used' is wrong on both counts (loader rejects a<=0; 0 of 9217 corpus cores have a=0) - erratum in the spec. || A93 consumer: the crowd certificate consumes checkCaseI_price twice (run A: cores=[] nofams=[]; run B: cores=[] with the exemption clause) and checkCaseI_facts for the total; see Crowd.crowd_sound.

V.PARAM — verify_param.py soundness (P0-P7) [lean-proved] LEAN-PROVED (A75): checkParamI = the verify_param.py decision core (4-D (t,cx,cy,s) B&B; clip at the cell wall SB; core_exempt_frac_iv = coreExempt on the centre-interval-shifted box; atom_inside_int_iv = projI with the atom widened to its exact s-cell interval over the lcm denominator; 4-axis split with tscale/sscale, s never split at a point/odd cell; 4^k root grid). checkParamI_price = (P2) at EVERY REAL side s of [s_lo,s_hi]; checkParamI_kill = the per-side hcert of Lemma B for the whole window from one PASS (the [S] theorem of soundness.md P3, in the form stratum_kill consumes); checkParamI_kill_packing = the lambda-dilated packing form. Pilot replay k5_06.param (full window, depth 56, native_decide, pickAll oracle): ParamK506.lean. Residual TCB = model faithfulness (table in A75 findings). Axioms: propext/Choice/Quot.sound (+ the native_decide axiom for the pilot only). || A117 (2026-09-06): NO-FAMILIES ADDED, as a NEW verifier version - attempts/A96-a57-parametric/code/verify_param_v2.py (sha256 153029ba...), v1 (0c58485c...) untouched and byte-identical before/after. v2 = v1 plus discharge rule (N): a placement whose centre lies in the s-affine zone Z(s) and whose t lies in one of the family's closed t-intervals is exempt, with the zone taken at its s-cell WORST CASE (the intersection over the cell, each edge affine so its extremes are at the endpoints) - conservative, it exempts less than the true zone at any single side. EQUIVALENCE MEASURED: verdict and every v1 statistic identical on 30 existing certificates (both classes, A57 sides G1/L1, levels 1-3, PASS and FAIL, A96 resolver cells, A100 protected classes, A99 level-3 k0 nodes, A57/A95/A61 certificates) - attempts/A117-verifier-v2/results/equivalence.json; v1 REFUSES a nofam, so zero regression surface. [T] LEMMA SAT FOR INTERIORS IS NO LONGER AN AXIOM: lean/PackingCertMathlib/PackingCertMathlib/SatInterior.lean proves sat_selection_thm with the EXACT statement of Local.lean's one project axiom sat_selection, from CaseSat.sat_squares plus Attain.mem_interior_iff_uv, and re-derives its one consumer as cover_pair'; axiom audit propext / Classical.choice / Quot.sound only. The shrink of local_certificate.md sec 1 needs no limit and no subsequence: with all eight gaps < 0 the four projection overlaps hold STRICTLY with the same right-hand side B = 1/2 + (|cos D| + |sin D|)/2, so with M = max of the four left-hand sides and lambda = (M/B + 1)/2 in (M/B, 1), sat_squares applies to the picture scaled by 1/lambda and its conclusion scales back with every coordinate <= lambda/2 < 1/2 -- strictly inside both squares; cos D < 0 is the u -> -u representation of the same square. [T/M] THE ARITHMETIC HALF OF A CONCRETE N IS NOW CHECKED IN THE KERNEL: LocalCert.lean is a reflected weak-duality checker over a certificate leaf (rational rows, Farkas multipliers, box), proved sound ONCE (checkLeaf_sound), with a string decoder so that 10^5-10^6 rational coefficients cost one token per leaf to ELABORATE instead of 10^5-10^6 numeric literals (finding E1: the elaborator, not the kernel, is what kills a generated file of this size). LocalCertS07(Data).lean replays ALL 2302 dead leaves of A119's S07_trump5_r0.10_rho40 (746 infeasibility rays, 27363 rows, 101629 nonzero coefficients) in ONE native_decide -- data 22 s, check 20 s -- and LocalCertS02(Data).lean does the same for S02_k5_11_r0.20_rho10 (32570 leaves, 5782 rays, 504404 rows, 1977332 coefficients), the N A120's node cover uses. localDead_s07 / localDead_s02 are Theorem LOCAL for those N modulo ONE named hypothesis, CertCover. [C] WHAT CertCover IS AND WHAT IT NEEDS: 'every packing satisfying N at a side in the CERTIFICATE'S OWN WINDOW [3.82, 3.897084] has an LP variable vector inside ONE recorded leaf's box satisfying that leaf's rows'. The window is load-bearing: restricted to s <= s0 the obligation would be a CONSEQUENCE of LocalDead (vacuously -- if N is dead there is no such s, z), the factorisation circular and the theorem empty; the certificate's window reaches ABOVE s0 = 3.877084, the cover argument never looks at s0, and lb_382 supplies the lower end free. It factors into the tilt cover (PROVED in shape: cover_bisect + a decidable structural check; no A119 certificate contains a qsplit node), the selection cover (the LOGIC is now a theorem via sat_selection_thm + cover_selection; what is missing is the interval enclosure sup_cell g_sigma < 0 -- 2969 excluded selections, 292 imp_sel leaves, 761 forced selections for S07 (0.1, 40 deg)), Lemma RELAX (its algebra is already proved in Local.lean; what is missing is that the rational constants bound the real ones), and the body-to-variable numbering. BOTH gaps reduce to ONE missing primitive: a certified rational-interval kernel for cos, sin and pi -- A119's exactiv.py in Lean -- and to nothing else. [F] THE CHEAPER ROUTE IS A GENERATOR CHANGE, NOT A LEAN ONE: the certificate's tilt variables are ANGLES, while Lean's own parametrisation t = tan(theta/2) makes cos and sin RATIONAL functions (Parametrize.cosT/sinT, cosT_sq_add_sinT_sq for every real t); a certificate emitted in t would make every enclosure exact rational arithmetic and take the trig kernel out of the trusted base entirely, at the cost of redoing the relaxation in t and re-solving every LP. [F] Two more findings: E2, check_local.Checker.dead RETURNS before its capture hook on an infeasibility ray, so a generator that trusts the hook silently emits an INCOMPLETE cover -- 746 of 2302 leaves (32 %) for S07 (0.1, 40 deg), 5782 of 32570 (18 %) for S02 (0.2, 10 deg); E3, Local.Box carries ONE interval in t and a packing's poses are normalised to t in [0,1], so a cell that leaves theta in [0, 90 deg] (S02 (0.2, 10 deg)'s BR(0,1) at [-10, +10] deg) is the union of TWO t-intervals and the emitted Box keeps only the inside part -- sound (a smaller N gives a weaker LocalDead), marked in the file, and fixed properly only by a tilt field that is a LIST of intervals, as CNoFam.tivs already is. [T] T3, THE COMPOSITION: LocalCompose.lean states and proves A120's tautologous cover in Lean -- yes_or_no (the split), localHyp_of_yes (A120's clauses A2/A3, pairwise pose-disjointness of the boxes and of boxes vs pins, are exactly what turns 'each box is occupied' into the INJECTIVITY LocalHyp demands), node_dead_of_yes_no, classKilledAt_of_yes_no -- and closes one gap A120 flagged: centre_in_slab (a packed square's centre is at least 1/2 from every wall, from wT_ge_one + set_subset_container_iff) gives noneIn_of_clamped, so a NO child certified against the CLAMPED zone kills the branch of the UNCLAMPED box, i.e. the clamp itself costs nothing (the ROUNDING does -- see F-COVER). y0230_dead is A120's closed node k5_11_interior_Y0230 as a Lean statement; what remains between 'dead in the ledger' and 'dead in Lean' is exactly its five hypotheses: LocalDead for S02 (0.2, 10 deg) modulo CertCover, A120's A2/A3 as decidable rational tests, the node's class hypothesis through the D4 frame map (A1/A4), and the four NO children -- whose consumer is checkCaseI_no_family (the zone list is NONEMPTY, so a PASS forces SOME non-owner square into the zone) and not checkCaseI_kill, with the IsStrictFamily-vs-interior-disjoint bridge (Dilation.lean's Lemma B) and the pose-vs-set step still between them, both pre-existing properties of the frozen fixed-side route. [F] F-COVER, measured on ALL FOUR of A120's closed nodes and all 17 of their PASSing NO certificates (code/zonecheck126.py, against A120's own full-precision records so the comparison is independent of the D4 frame map): the tautologous split needs ZONE contained in BOX (a configuration that fails YES fails it because no square is in BOX_i, and to land in NO_i it must have no square in ZONE_i either), and A120's runner builds the zone EXACTLY, but the case-measure-certificate emits it rounded OUTWARD -- the tilt interval converted to t = tan(theta/2) and rounded out to 2^-20 / 2^-23, the centre rectangle to 9 decimals by nearest -- which is the right direction for the VERIFIER (a wider NO zone exempts more, justified by the correspondingly stronger hypothesis) and the wrong one for the COVER. So EVERY closed node's cover leaves a sliver of width 9.0e-8..1.10e-7 in tilt (all 17 children) and <= 4.71e-10 in the upper centre bounds (13 of 17) in NEITHER branch. Nothing in A120's LP or measure work is wrong; the tautology is, and the fix is one rounding direction (emit the zone INWARD) plus a re-certification at amounts orders of magnitude below the resolution at which those certificates pass.
